title: Sign PDF: Add Your Signature to a PDF Free, No Upload
description: Sign PDF documents in your browser: draw, type or upload your signature, add the date and initials, and download. Free, no account, no upload.
promise: Sign PDF documents yourself in a minute: draw, type or upload your signature, place it on the page, add a date, and download. Everything runs on your device.

app.name: Sign PDF
featureList: Draw, type or upload a signature image
Place, resize and move it on any page
Add text such as the date, name or initials
Optionally flatten so the signature cannot be moved
Runs in the browser, nothing is uploaded

outline.label: Draw, type or upload a signature
Add the date, your name and initials
Is an electronic signature legally valid?
